en: $s05Then $s80$s13why are Mechasaurs and Hyakki Beasts here together...?

They'd lost their masters and seemed to be wandering with nowhere to go! So I enlightened them!$/$s05About a new savior worthy of their service! $s80$s13$s05About the existence of Lord Lando!$/$s13...Well, $s80$s13they did need a few modifications first!
Speaking of which, young lady, $s80$s13I hear you've been looking for one Shinichi Tachibana?
$s05You know where he is?! $s80$s13Where is he?!
$s20I don't need to tell you... $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13because he's right here!

That light Uzahra gave off $s80$s13$s80$s13was a weapon that cuts off gravity for an instant $s80$s13$s80$s13and reverses the Earth's axis...

Fortunately, $s80$s13a full reversal was avoided, $s80$s13$s80$s13but the Earth's axis has tilted, $s80$s13$s80$s13and because of that $s80$s13the magma in the Earth's core has begun to churn violently.

Within a few hours, most likely, $s80$s13$s80$s13a tidal wave 300 meters high will sweep as far as the continental highlands, $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13and within a few days $s80$s13$s80$s13volcanoes all over the world will erupt...
Mankind $s80$s13may be about to face something it has never known before, $s80$s13$s80$s13an age of darkness...
Shinichi! $s80$s13Shinichi Tachibana! $s80$s13$s80$s13Sortie with the Metal Beast reinforcements! $s80$s13$s80$s13Crush the Allied Forces, the Texas and all!
$s30My head...$/$s13My head feels like it's splitting $s80$s13$s30open!
He looks like he's in real agony...
$s05Tch! $s80$s13So the modifications weren't complete after all!
$s20...My body! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13$s20My heart!... $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20What has become of me?! $s80$s13Ngh!
...It's you people... $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13$s13It's because you people $s80$s13are here!

en: $s80$s13So, $s80$s13how's it looking? The Getter, I mean.

You can't tell by looking at it, but the finer components have been under heavy strain.$/We threw it into real combat without enough testing, after all.$/We'll do a thorough maintenance job and collect data while we're at it.
note: Editorial: 'the fine parts have taken a heavy strain' / 'give it a thorough maintenance' reworded for natural English.

en: This job means correcting calculation errors made at the design stage.$/It's closer to a refit than a repair. Even the Kujira's facilities can't handle this.
With us out of action, the Allied Forces are spread thin right now. $s80$s13So make it quick, okay?
note: Editorial: 'So I'm counting on you to hurry' -> 'So make it quick, okay?' (Ryoma asking Saotome; hayame ni tanomu ze, rough voice).
